title: Business Development Executive

description:

title: Graduate Medical Sales Representative - Dermatology & Allergy
description:
Evolve Selection is exclusively partnering with a leading global pharmaceutical company to deliver an exciting new team build across the UK.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a brand-new team as a Healthcare Partnership Associate, representing an innovative portfolio of products across Dermatology and Allergy. You'll have the opportunity to help shape and grow a developing team, build valuable relationships across primary care and make a real contribution to improving patient outcomes.

Combining scientific engagement, relationship building and commercial ownership, you'll work in partnership with healthcare professionals to identify opportunities, develop your territory and deliver meaningful value across these exciting therapeutic areas.

Whether you're a recent graduate looking to launch your career in the pharmaceutical industry, an entry-level sales professional ready for your next step, or an experienced medical sales professional seeking a new challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Previous pharmaceutical experience is not essential, with training and development available to support those new to the industry.

This is a full-time, permanent position covering the East of England region of the UK, with exact territory boundaries to be confirmed. Please note that a full, valid UK driving licence is essential for this role.

What s on offer?
- Highly Competitive starting salary of £35,000, plus exceptional benefits package - including bonus, car allowance, pension, holiday buy back scheme and more!
- Innovative Product Portfolio - Work with leading dermatology and allergy products in a specialist market.
- Collaborative Culture - Thrive in a supportive, people-focused environment.

Ideal Requirements:
- Open to Graduates and Entry-Level Professionals - Previous pharmaceutical experience is not essential. We welcome applications from graduates and early-career professionals with transferable skills, enthusiasm and a desire to build a career in pharmaceutical sales.
- A Passion for Healthcare and Learning - A degree in a scientific, healthcare or related discipline is desirable, alongside a genuine interest in healthcare and a willingness to develop strong clinical and product knowledge. We welcome applications from both experienced professionals and graduates with transferable skills who are keen to build a career in pharmaceutical sales.
- Strong Relationship-Building and Communication Skills - The ability to build credible, lasting relationships with healthcare professionals and other key stakeholders. You will be confident communicating, influencing and adapting your approach to meet different customer needs.
- Commercial Awareness and a Drive to Succeed - A proactive, results-focused mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities, work towards objectives and contribute to business growth. Previous experience in a target-driven commercial or healthcare environment would be advantageous.
- Self-Motivation and Effective Territory Management - The confidence and initiative to work independently, manage your time effectively and take ownership of a geographical territory. You will be organised, adaptable and comfortable planning your activities to maximise opportunities.
- A Commitment to Professional Excellence - A commitment to working ethically and responsibly within the pharmaceutical industry. An understanding of the ABPI Code, previous pharmaceutical sales experience and an ABPI qualification would be advantageous, although support and development will be available for candidates new to the industry.

Role Responsibilities:
- Build Meaningful Healthcare Partnerships - Develop trusted, long-term relationships with GPs, practice-based clinicians, community pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, becoming a valued partner and a recognised source of clinical and product expertise within your territory.
- Drive Territory Growth and Commercial Success - Take ownership of your territory, identifying new opportunities, developing strategic business plans and using sales data and market insights to maximise growth, achieve sales targets and deliver outstanding commercial results.
- Deliver Engaging, Clinically Relevant Customer Conversations - Bring clinical evidence to life through high-quality, tailored discussions that demonstrate the benefits, appropriate use and value of specialist products, supporting healthcare professionals to make informed decisions that benefit patients.
- Shape Local Healthcare Opportunities Through Collaboration - Work closely with internal colleagues and cross-functional teams to develop effective engagement strategies, strengthen local partnerships and align product offerings with NHS priorities and evolving patient needs, including opportunities within Pharmacy First.
- Champion Professional Excellence and Patient Outcomes - Operate with integrity and professionalism, maintaining excellent clinical and product knowledge while ensuring all activities meet ABPI and regulatory standards. Keep patients at the heart of every interaction and ensure responsible use of resources.

Recruitment Process:

2 stage interview and assessment process

Interview with a hiring manager who is a passionate and experienced leader, values your ideas, mentors your growth, and is committed to helping you succeed in this role.

Excited to learn more? Click apply or reach out to our recruitment team for full details!

Application Process:

Evolve Selection acts as a recruitment partner on behalf of our clients. All applications are reviewed by our specialist consultants and assessed against the specific requirements of the role. Suitable candidates will be contacted for an initial discussion before being introduced to the hiring client.

We appreciate every application; however, due to application volumes, we may not be able to respond to all candidates individually. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days, please consider your application unsuccessful for this particular role, however we may contact you regarding future opportunities that match your experience in line with our privacy policy.

Evolve is a leading recruitment and outsourcing organisation, operating within the Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Medical Device and Life Science sectors.

Equal opportunities are important to us. We believe that diversity and inclusion are critical to our success as a company, We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of background, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, ethnicity, belief, age, family or parental status, and any other characteristic.

title: Home Sales Consultant - Flooring
description:
Our client, the largest UK retailer of carpets and flooring, are looking for sales-driven and customer-focused individuals to join their expanding team of Home Consultants. Working from your own Mobile Showroom (vehicle provided), you will spend most of your time on the road, working with stores, and visiting customers homes every day.

You will have the opportunity to provide customers with great end-to-end service by helping, advising, and measuring flooring. Using your knowledge of exceptional product ranges and in-house software you will bring customers ideas to life in the comfort of their own home and, while doing so, earn a generous commission!

Outstanding customer service skills will be essential as well as the ability to maximise sales via internet leads by presenting suitable products to the customer in their home.

Full, extensive training provided.

Basic salary of £21,850, with OTE of £40,000 £45,000 including commission, plus a generous range of benefits

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Are you a natural relationship builder with a passion for sales and a knack for spotting opportunities?

We're working with an established and growing business in Cambridgeshire, that is looking for a motivated and commercially minded Internal Sales Executive to join its busy sales team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys building customer relationships, generating new business and making a real difference to commercial performance.

Whether you're already working in internal sales, account management or a customer-facing sales environment, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity

This is far more than simply processing orders or responding to enquiries!

You'll play an active role in driving sales growth, developing existing accounts, identifying new opportunities and helping customers find the right products and solutions.

Working closely with an experienced sales team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of customer relationships and contribute directly to the success of the business.

What You'll Be Doing
- Building and developing strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
- Proactively contacting customers to identify new sales opportunities.
- Following up enquiries, quotations and samples to convert interest into sales.
- Identifying opportunities to cross-sell and upsell products and services.
- Reconnecting with dormant customers and developing new business.
- Understanding customer requirements and recommending appropriate solutions.
- Managing customer information and sales activity through the CRM system.
- Working towards individual and team sales targets.
- Collaborating with colleagues to ensure customers receive an excellent service.

What We're Looking For

We're keen to speak with individuals who have a positive attitude, plenty of initiative and a genuine enthusiasm for sales.

Ideally, you'll bring:
- Previous experience in internal sales, account management or a customer-facing commercial role.
- Confidence speaking with customers over the telephone and via email.
- A proactive approach to developing business rather than simply waiting for enquiries.
- Strong relationship-building and communication skills.
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Experience using CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
- The ability to learn new products quickly and communicate their benefits.
- A collaborative, enthusiastic and customer-focused approach.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone with commercial curiosity, resilience and the confidence to pick up the phone and create opportunities.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

You'll be joining an established business where customer relationships, product knowledge and proactive selling are genuinely valued.

This role offers the opportunity to develop your sales skills, build long-term customer partnerships and make a visible contribution to business growth.

If you're looking for a position where you can combine customer relationships with proactive sales activity, this could be an excellent next step.

title: Sales Executive - New Business Solutions
description:
KONE is looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Sales Executive to join our New Building Solutions team. This is an exciting opportunity to drive sales growth across a thriving construction market, building relationships with developers, contractors and consultants while delivering major new-build projects.

We're seeking a proven B2 B sales professional with experience in business development, account management and complex solution sales. You may come from the lift industry, construction, building products, engineering, mechanical or electrical services, or another technical sales environment.

Working for one of the world's leading elevator and escalator companies, you'll be responsible for developing opportunities from initial engagement through to contract award, helping customers overcome challenges and achieve their long-term goals.

Territory - Peterborough, Cambridge, Milton Keynes, Luton and the wider East Anglia region.

OTE £75,000-£80,000

Key Responsibilities
- Build and develop relationships with customers, consultants, contractors and developers across your territory.
- Generate new business while growing existing accounts to strengthen KONE's market position.
- Identify, manage and convert opportunities to achieve order intake, revenue and profitability targets.
- Manage the full sales cycle, including tender submissions, negotiations, contract award and handover.
- Promote and upsell KONE's digital and smart building solutions.
- Deliver outstanding customer service and support long-term customer relationships.
- Maintain accurate pipeline, customer and opportunity data within Salesforce.
- Provide timely forecasting, reporting and sales activity updates.
- Conduct regular customer meetings across the territory (typically 2-3 days per week).
- Collaborate with colleagues across KONE to maximise cross-selling opportunities.

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Proven B2 B sales and account management experience, including new business development and customer retention.
- Strong track record of managing complex sales opportunities and delivering against targets.
- Excellent negotiation, commercial and relationship-building skills.
- Experience managing tenders, proposals and customer contracts.
- Good understanding of contractual and financial terms.
- Experience using CRM systems, ideally Salesforce.

Desirable
- Lift/elevator industry experience.
- Construction, building products or built-environment sales experience.
- Technical, engineering or specification sales background.

What KONE can offer:

We offer a competitive salary, 25 days + Bank Holidays +1 paid Volunteering Day, Company Pension Scheme, Private Medical Insurance, Quarterly Commission, EV Car, PDI, Dental Insurance, Gymflex Membership, Life/Partner Assurance & Critical Illness Issurance, Kone Discounts, Cycle to Work Scheme, Long Service Awards, 24/7 GP Support & Wellbeing Access, Employee Assistance Programme, Hybrid Working and Career Development Opportunities to support and help you achieve your goals.

title: Outside Account Manager
description:
Outside Account Manager - Peterborough - up to £40,000 + Company car

Our Client is a dynamic and progressive metals and plastic distributor. They are looking for an Outside Account Manager to join their team in Peterborough.

Key responsibilities of the Account Manager:
- Reviews market analysis and determines customer needs, potential volume, pricing schedule.
- Develops accounts sales campaigns.
- Proactively contacts customers and maintains relationships with those who have existing and business development opportunities and/or have had a history of purchasing from our sister company.
- Travel to customer sites to meet with appropriate stakeholders.
- Increase sales and average order size by means of cross-selling, up-selling and value add services such as fabrication, processing, polishing etc.
- Manage customer needs and ensure a high level of customer service.
- Negotiate terms appropriately to close deal.
- Obtains and relates customer, service and inventory data to appropriate Manager.
- Prepares appropriate reports in agreed format and to agreed timescales.
- Work with the Vice President - Europe (Specialty Distribution or Aerospace) and Business Development Manager to help organise global exhibitions.
- Manage and maintain in-house CRM system keeping compressive records of activities.
- Clearly communicate progress against agreed targets - in format agreed.
- Forecast and track key account metrics.
- Assist with challenging customer requests.
- Liaise with internal sales team to ensure customers' needs are managed appropriately

Key skills of the Account Manager:
- At least 2 years proven account management experience ideally in commercial / aerospace sectors / metals industry
- Tenacious and highly motivated and able to work individually or in a team
- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively both written and verbal
- Ability to influence key stakeholders at all levels of an organisation
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint

Company benefits available for the Account Manager:

Salary - up to £40,000 plus company car

Peterborough office - office based when not out visiting customers.

23 days annual leave (plus Bank Holidays) rising to 28 with service

Pension - 5% employee contribution, 3% employer (rises with service - max 8%)
